title: Studio recovers unattended after a power cut or reboot: auto-login, herdr sessions at login, Tailscale at login, reboot test
description: Measured 2026-09-10 on mac-studio: pmset autorestart=1 (powers back on) and FileVault off (no unlock screen), BUT no automatic login is configured (no autoLoginUser, no /etc/kcpassword), so after a power cut or an automatic macOS update (AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates=1) the Studio stops at the login window and none of the user LaunchAgents start: rakazo api/worker/sandbox-supervisor/web/caddy, sweech, fed, keel daemon, Tailscale app, OrbStack (→ Postgres), Amphetamine. herdr agents/agents-kc sessions are not recreated at login; agents-kc must be created from the GUI session for keychain access. Fix: (1) automatic login for user luke (Luke runs: sudo sysadminctl -autologin set -userName luke -password - ; also unlocks the login keychain); (2) a LaunchAgent com.rakazo.herdr-sessions (RunAtLoad) that starts herdr servers 'agents' and 'agents-kc' with a workspace 'rakazo-lanes' if absent; (3) confirm Tailscale launches at login and tcp 443 serve config persists; (4) decide automatic macOS update install for the trip (off, or allowed because auto-login recovers). AC (runtime, one real reboot): sudo shutdown -r now on the Studio → within 5 min, without touching the Studio: iPhone app reaches https://rakazo.czaku.com and a bot replies; launchctl list shows com.rakazo.* running; docker postgres up; herdr session list shows agents + agents-kc; keychain probe KC=0 in agents-kc.

context.text: Code/ops part merged (codex PASS round 2). Still owed before done: Luke enables auto-login in System Settings; install com.rakazo.herdr-sessions per APPLY §9; one real reboot test.

Reconciled a duplicate supervisor: a teammate had hand-created ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.luke.herdr-agents.plist (KeepAlive herdr server for the 'agents' session only) before this task's own artefact was installed. Verified com.rakazo.herdr-sessions.plist is the merged, codex-PASS (round 2, commit d51ca5a) artefact on luke/studio-setup, guard path exists and is executable, and it covers both 'agents' and 'agents-kc' (the ad hoc plist covered only 'agents' and never created agents-kc). Installed com.rakazo.herdr-sessions.plist per APPLY.md Section 9 (bootstrap gui/$(id -u); note this machine's uid is 502, not 501 as an earlier report assumed), confirmed idempotent (log: 'agents already running', 'agents-kc already running', KC=0), then booted out and deleted com.luke.herdr-agents.plist so there is exactly one supervisor. Live agents session (PID 49277, holding the vyke.ai/question-549 codex lane) was never touched; pane list verified working before and after. Still owed before done: Luke enables auto-login (no autoLoginUser/kcpassword configured yet — auto-login is the reason this LaunchAgent cannot fire on an unattended reboot) and one real reboot test. See reports/remote-mac-studio-setup/rakazo-013.md for full evidence.
